rows.answer: NOT FOUND

rows.question: For the Bard PH13 single package heat pump, what minimum distance must be provided between the coil inlet and any building surfaces?
rows.answer: A minimum of 24 inches should be provided between the coil inlet and any building surfaces [1].

rows.question: Which low ambient control kit is required if the Bard PH13 single package heat pump is operated in cooling below 55° outdoor ambient temperature?
rows.answer: Low ambient controls CMH-15 must be installed on the Bard PH13 unit if it is operated in cooling below a 55° outdoor ambient temperature [1].

rows.question: The Bard PH13 single package heat pump leaves the factory wired on the 240V transformer tap. What must be done for 208V operation?
rows.answer: For 208V operation, reconnect the transformer from the 240V tap to the 208V tap [1]. The acceptable operating voltage range is 220 - 187 for the 208 tap (253 - 216 for the 240 tap), measured at the field power connection point in the unit while it is operating at full load [1].

rows.question: When servicing the Bard PH13 single package heat pump with R-410A, above what temperature must refrigerant cylinders never be heated?
rows.answer: Refrigerant cylinders must never be heated above 125°F [1].

rows.question: On a three phase Bard PH13 single package heat pump, the red fault LED on the phase monitor is lit and the scroll compressor will not run. What is the cause?
rows.answer: The phases are reversed. The three phase line monitor lights the red fault LED and inhibits compressor operation when the phases are reversed (to prevent compressor damage due to phase reversal). To correct the fault, reverse two of the supply leads to the unit; do not reverse any of the unit factory wires, as damage may occur [1].

rows.question: On the Bard PH13 heat pump control board, which terminals are jumpered to simulate a 0° coil temperature so the defrost cycle can be checked in warmer weather?
rows.answer: The SEN JMP terminals (the initiate defrost jumper, "sen jump") are jumpered; a 1/4 inch QC terminal works best. Placing a jumper across the SEN JMP terminals shunts out the defrost sensor mounted on the outdoor coils and activates the timing circuit, simulating a 0° coil temperature so the defrost cycle can be checked in warmer weather [1]. The jumper must be removed to terminate the defrost test; if left in place too long the compressor could stop due to the high pressure control opening [1][8].

rows.question: When checking the defrost temperature sensor resistance on the Bard PH13 single package heat pump, what is the tolerance of the part?
rows.answer: The tolerance of the part is ± 10% [1].

rows.question: On the Bard PH13 single package heat pump, switching to the heating cycle at or above what outside temperature may cause a nuisance trip of the high pressure switch?
rows.answer: Switching to the heating cycle at 75°F or higher outside temperature may cause a nuisance trip of the high pressure switch [1].

rows.question: What brazing material is recommended for the suction and discharge tubes of the scroll compressor on the Bard PH13 single package heat pump?
rows.reference: silfos with minimum 5% silver or silver braze material with flux
rows.answer: For the Bard PH13, the recommended brazing materials are silfos with minimum 5% silver, or silver braze material with flux [1].

rows.question: The X13 ECM blower motor on a Bard PH13 single package heat pump has proper high voltage and proper low voltage at a programmed terminal but is not operating. What is the remedy?
rows.reference: the motor is failed, and will require replacement
rows.answer: If the motor has proper high voltage (as checked at the (L/L1) (G) (N/L2) connections) and proper low voltage to a programmed terminal, and is not operating, the motor is failed and will require replacement [1][2].

rows.question: What is the sound rating in decibels of the Bard PH13 single package heat pump at rated airflow?
rows.answer: NOT FOUND

rows.question: How many years is the compressor warranty on the Bard PH13 single package heat pump?
rows.answer: NOT FOUND

rows.question: Why must caution be exercised when servicing a single-phase Rheem 13 SEER heat pump that uses a single-pole compressor contactor?
rows.reference: only one leg of the power supply is broken with the contactor
rows.answer: Because single-pole contactors are used on all standard single-phase units up through 5 tons, and only one leg of the power supply is broken with the contactor [1][2]. Since the contactor may break only one side, all power to the unit must be disconnected before servicing; failure to shut off power can cause electrical shock resulting in personal injury or death [7].

rows.question: What is the factory refrigerant charge per circuit, in ounces [grams], for the size 60 Rheem 13 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: NOT FOUND

rows.question: What clearance is required above the fan discharge (unit top) of the Rheem 13 SEER heat pump to prevent recirculation?
rows.answer: 60" [1524 mm] of clearance is required above the heat pump fan discharge (unit top) to prevent recirculation [1]. This 60-inch [1524 mm] discharge clearance must not be reduced, even where space limitations exist [3].

rows.question: What is the maximum length of interconnecting refrigerant line allowed on the Rheem 13 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: The maximum length of interconnecting line is 150 feet [45.7 m]. Always use the shortest length possible with a minimum number of bends; additional compressor oil is not required for any length up to 150 feet [45.7 m] [1].

rows.question: To what maximum pressure should the line set and coil of a Rheem 13 SEER heat pump be pressurized with dry nitrogen for leak testing?
rows.answer: Pressurize the line set and coil through the service fittings with dry nitrogen to 150 PSIG [1034.2 kPa] maximum. Leak test all joints using liquid detergent; if a leak is found, relieve pressure and repair [1].

rows.question: On the Rheem 13 SEER heat pump enhanced feature defrost control, LED 1 and LED 2 are both steadily ON. What does this diagnostic code mean?
rows.answer: LED 1 ON and LED 2 ON indicates a Coil Sensor Failure [1].

rows.question: To what vacuum level should a Rheem 13 SEER heat pump system be evacuated before opening the service valves?
rows.answer: Evacuate the system to 500 microns and hold 500 microns or less for at least 15 minutes [3]. After adequate evacuation, the service valves are opened [2].

rows.question: What transformer is required for the control circuit of the Rheem 13 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: A 24 volt, 40 VA minimum transformer (together with a thermostat) is required for the control circuit of the condensing unit. The furnace or the air handler transformer may be used if sufficient [1].

rows.question: What is the part number of the low ambient control accessory (cooling mode only) for the Rheem 13 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: The low ambient control (LAC) - cooling mode only - is part number RXAD-A08 [1].

rows.question: On a Rheem 13 SEER heat pump the outdoor fan runs but the compressor does not, and the internal overload is open. What should be done before replacing the compressor?
rows.reference: Wait at least 2 hours for overload to reset
rows.answer: Wait at least 2 hours for the overload to reset. If it is still open, replace the compressor [1]. (The electrical troubleshooting table likewise says to allow the internal overload time to reset [2].)

rows.question: What microfarad rating is the run capacitor for the outdoor fan motor on the 3 ton Rheem 13 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: NOT FOUND

rows.question: How many years does the manufacturer's warranty cover the compressor on the Rheem 14.5 SEER heat pump?
rows.answer: NOT FOUND
